verdict.rationale: The common register portal says structured register information is offered for retrieval where the states provide it, as a non-binding service (docs-11). The Unternehmensregister gives access to register entries and filed documents (docs-2), so machine-readable per-company extracts exist in some form. Everything evidenced is per-record retrieval behind a search UI, and the front-page overload notices from high retrieval volumes (docs-13) suggest heavy users pull record by record rather than from a bulk feed. Missing for 10: any documented bulk dataset or full-register download, defined formats or schemas for the structured extracts, consistent coverage across states (the service is non-binding and state-dependent), and any statistics or extract datasets.
